title: Checkout retry double-charges when the webhook times out
body: Acme's finance lead pasted a Stripe event in #incidents. The invoice webhook hit our 10s timeout, Stripe retried, and we created a second charge instead of treating the event id as already seen. Two customers so far, both on the annual plan. Maya is in the handler.

title: Okta SSO loops on the callback for Brightline
body: Brightline's admin can start Okta login and lands back on /login with no error. Their IdP log shows a successful assertion. We don't have an owner yet. Repro is in the Zendesk ticket, screen recording attached there.

title: Search still returns docs the customer deleted
body: Deleting a doc from the workspace removes it from the library and leaves it in search results until a full reindex. Northwind noticed a draft salary note show up for a teacher who shouldn't see it. Priya thinks the delete path never writes a tombstone to the index.

title: iOS push notifications landing 10+ minutes late
body: Hearth's on-call rotation says mention pushes on iOS show up 10 to 20 minutes after the in-app badge. Android is fine. Lena hasn't reproduced it on a device she trusts yet, so this is still New.

title: CSV export splits columns that contain commas
body: The members export doesn't quote fields. A team named "Design, Research" becomes two columns and every row after that shifts. Cobalt's HRIS import rejected the file. Chris has a failing test locally and is arguing with himself about whether to pull in a csv package or keep the hand-rolled writer.

title: Avatar crop is blurry on retina displays
body: The cropper exports a 64px jpeg and we stretch it to 128 on the settings page. Looks soft on any recent Mac. Nobody is hurt. Triaged so it doesn't keep getting re-reported. No owner.

title: On-call page 500s after Tuesday's deploy
body: The schedule page called a column we dropped in the same deploy. Rolled back, then Maya put the read behind the new shape. Resolved after the second deploy stayed green through handover. Keeping it here so the postmortem has something to point at.

title: Password reset mail goes straight to spam for Outlook
body: Lumen's IT only allows Outlook. Reset mail lands in junk and the link is rewritten by their scanner, so the token is dead by the time a human clicks it. Priya is moving the link to a short redirect that survives the rewrite. Not done.

title: Invite empty state says "your're"
body: Typo on the invite empty state. Lena fixed the copy. Shipped in the Wednesday front-end release.

title: 429 responses are missing the Retry-After header
body: Paperkite's integration backs off for a full minute because we return 429 with an empty body and no Retry-After. The limit window is 10 seconds. Chris confirmed it on staging and wants it in the same change as the CSV quoting, so we only cut one API release.

title: Deleted page still shows up in workspace search
body: Same Northwind report, second thread. Jordan didn't see Priya's ticket and filed this from #support. Linking it as a duplicate so we don't triage it twice. The salary-note part lives on TB-1877.

title: Audit log export times out for orgs past 50k events
body: Hearth's security review wants a full audit export. The job runs until the gateway times out once an org is past about 50k events. Came over with the Jira import last month. Their scale went past P3 and this one was left as P10. Nobody has re-ranked it.

title: Slack unfurl shows the old doc title after a rename
body: Rename a doc and the Slack unfurl keeps the old title until the link is posted again. Sable's legal team thought they were looking at a draft that had already been renamed. Maya looked once and thinks we cache the unfurl payload for 7 days with no bust on title change.

title: Tab key gets stuck inside the assignee menu
body: On the share dialog, tab moves into the assignee list and never leaves it. Shift-tab is stuck too. Nia hit this while keyboard-testing the dialog. Easy to miss if you only click. Nobody has time this week, so it stays New on purpose.

title: Zendesk sidebar widget is blank in Firefox 132
body: Support agents on Firefox get an empty sidebar where the Northstar widget should be. Chrome is fine. Console shows a syntax error in a helper we shipped in the widget bundle. Lena hasn't pulled the branch yet. Volume is low, but the agents who hit it can't see account status.
